content: 2026 default test stack for a Vite+React app: Vitest (shares Vite config, ESM-native, ~5-10x faster cold start than Jest, 52% adoption in State of JS 2025) + React Testing Library for component/unit tests, and a small Playwright suite (3-5 critical E2E flows: login, contract lifecycle, inspection photo flow, PDF download) wired into CI. MSW recommended for mocking the wheelio-api REST layer in both unit and integration tests.
